_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: The context usage popup remembers which graphs are on across page loads. The screen is 1280x800. "The popup" is ".chat-context-popup"; "the svg" is its ".token-cost-graph-svg"; "checkbox X" is the popup's checkbox whose accessible name contains X. Accessible names: an element's name is its aria-label if it has one; otherwise a button's name is its text with whitespace collapsed and trimmed, leaving out aria-hidden parts, and a dialog's name is the text of the element its aria-labelledby refers to; "named X" means the name is exactly X. Only elements that are not display: none count. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}} and click ".context-usage-label". 2. The svg should be visible (allow 30s) with exactly 3 "g[data-pane]". 3. Click checkbox "Cumulative cost": the svg should have exactly 2 "g[data-pane]". 4. Reload (navigate to /c/{{SLUG}} again) and click ".context-usage-label". 5. The svg should be visible (allow 30s), with exactly 2 "g[data-pane]" and no g[data-pane="cumulative"] (count 0). Checkbox "Context length" should be checked, checkbox "Cumulative cost" not checked, and checkbox "Incremental cost" checked. 6. Click checkbox "Context length", then checkbox "Incremental cost": there should be no svg (count 0). 7. Reload (navigate to /c/{{SLUG}} again) and click ".context-usage-label". 8. Checkbox "Context length" should be visible and not checked (allow 30s), and there should be no svg (count 0).
